title: Effective
body:
While I have been using this App, I slowly started to achieve a consistent habit every day. Sometimes I missed to do but I made up next day. 
This App works for me well. 
I wish if I can add just one more task, it would be so good 2 tasks a day. 
I like this App, so I accomplish 30 days and try next one as keep doing first task.
author: Tmtmtmtko
